column7: \func conv {A : Ring} (a b : Series A) : Series A
\func uconv (a b : Series ExUpperReal) : Series ExUpperReal
\lemma conv-norm_<= {A : ExPseudoNormedRing} (a b : Series A) (n : Nat) : norm (conv a b n) <= uconv (\lam j => norm (a j)) (\lam j => norm (b j)) n
\lemma conv_fromRat {A : RealBanachAlgebra} (a b : Series Rat) (k : Nat) : conv (\lam n => A.fromRat (a n)) (\lam n => A.fromRat (b n)) k = A.fromRat (conv a b k)
\lemma partialSum-uconv-square {a b : Series ExUpperReal} (a>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= a n) (b>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= b n) {n : Nat} : partialSum (uconv a b) n <= partialSum a n * partialSum b n

\lemma midSum-uconv-bound {a b : Series ExUpperReal} (a>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= a n) (b>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= b n) {N M n : Nat} (MN : 2 Nat.* M <= N) (ab : \Pi (i : Nat) -> (a i).IsBounded) (bb : \Pi (j : Nat) -> (b j).IsBounded) : midSum (uconv a b) N n <= midSum a M n * partialSum b n + partialSum a n * midSum b M n
\lemma partialSum-from-termBound {S : Series ExUpperReal} {B : Rat} (hB : \Pi (n : Nat) -> (S n).U B) (n : Nat) : ∃ (C : Rat) ((partialSum S n).U C)
\lemma partialSum-uniform-bound {S : Series ExUpperReal} (S>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= S n) (Sb : IsBoundedUpperSeries S) (Sc : IsConvUpperSeries S) : ∃ (B : Rat) ∀ (n : Nat) ((partialSum S n).U B)

\lemma uconv-conv {a b : Series ExUpperReal} (a>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= a n) (b>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= b n) (aB : IsBoundedUpperSeries a) (bB : IsBoundedUpperSeries b) (ac : IsConvUpperSeries a) (bc : IsConvUpperSeries b) : IsConvUpperSeries (uconv a b)
\lemma conv-absConv {A : ExPseudoNormedRing} {a b : Series A} (ac : IsAbsConvSeries a) (bc : IsAbsConvSeries b) : IsAbsConvSeries (conv a b)

\lemma conv-sum {A : ExPseudoNormedRing} {a b : Series A} {sa sb : A} (ac : IsSeriesSum a sa) (bc : IsSeriesSum b sb) (ac-abs : IsAbsConvSeries a) (bc-abs : IsAbsConvSeries b) : IsSeriesSum (conv a b) (sa * sb)

\lemma conv-seriesSum {A : CompleteExNormedRing} {a b : Series A} (ac-abs : IsAbsConvSeries a) (bc-abs : IsAbsConvSeries b) : IsSeriesSum (conv a b) (seriesSum a (absConv-isConv ac-abs) * seriesSum b (absConv-isConv bc-abs))
